name: 西游记 4.2
group_note: 西游记4.2.rar in the same batch is a line-ending-only duplicate of this archive (identical file tree, every file differs only by CRLF vs LF) -- processed once, .rar counted as a duplicate rather than a separate entry. No master-hash match to any existing lib. Boots clean with zero fixes needed. Full WASM pass: added loopback-allow to band.lpc; fixed the euid-reset-by-stray-seteuid(getuid()) bug in logind.lpc's make_body(); fixed check_legal_name()'s stale GBK byte-length bounds; guarded securityd.lpc's get_status() defensively. Also found and fixed a genuine compile blocker in adm/daemons/combatd.lpc: a switch(random(4)) block had its real case labels commented out, leaving only a bare `default:` -- illegal on this driver (a switch needs at least one real case, not just default), failing the whole file's compile and breaking every combat-adjacent code path (silently, since the error only surfaces the first time something actually calls into combatd). Replaced the switch with a plain block since the commented-out cases meant it was never doing real branching anyway. Registration through world-entry, look/score, and quit are all cleanly verified with no residual timing flakiness; note this lineage asks for email BEFORE gender, opposite of some sibling lineages -- read the actual input_to() chain rather than assuming order.
